description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the search functionality of the Apache Fineract platform. It tests search queries across different resources such as clients, client identifiers, groups, savings, shares, and loans, ensuring search results are returned correctly, including both positive and negative test cases.

classes.name: SearchResourcesTest
classes.description: This class contains setup and test methods to validate the search API functionality within the Fineract integration test suite.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the REST assured configurations and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: searchAnyValueOverAllResources
methods.description: Tests searching for a random string across multiple resources and ensures no results are returned for a non-existent query.

methods.name: searchAnyValueOverClientResources
methods.description: Tests searching with a random string within client resources, expecting no results.

methods.name: searchOverClientResources
methods.description: Creates a client, then searches for its account number, verifying the search successfully retrieves the created client.

methods.name: searchAnyValueOverLoanResources
methods.description: Tests searching for a random string within loan resources, expecting no results.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Helps format the resources list into a comma-separated string for search API requests.
